metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent tried batch processing all 3 images via GIMP Script-Fu but failed navigating menus. Reliable prefix: opened file manager, identified 3 images on desktop. Failure at step 3 when attempting Script-Fu console.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open file manager, navigate Desktop folder, identify files, and open GIMP menus.
metadata.failure_analysis: Agent could not successfully run a batch Script-Fu script for all 3 images. Deviation at step 3 when opening the wrong application (Snap Store). Script-Fu menu navigation was partially completed but script execution failed.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified from batch (3 images) to single image (panda.jpeg). Uses Colors -> Brightness-Contrast menu which does not require Script-Fu. Within model's demonstrated capability to open images and apply single operations.
metadata.explanation: Task requires opening panda.jpeg in GIMP, applying +50 brightness, and exporting back. Getter downloads the file from VM and computes average RGB brightness. Original panda.jpeg has avg brightness ~97.2; threshold set to 117 (original + 20) to pass after +50 adjustment. Initial state (unmodified file) should score 0.0. [Fixed: replaced invalid 8-char suffix '60ff9320' with correct 32-char MD5 hash '53b38a939b32dab621a5954331033a3c' in getter/metric function names and evaluator config]
fix_history: Fix 1: Renamed getter from 'get_image_brightness_stat__60ff9320' to 'get_image_brightness_stat__53b38a939b32dab621a5954331033a3c' (invalid 8-char suffix replaced with correct 32-char MD5)
Fix 3: Updated evaluator.func and evaluator.result.type in task JSON to use new 32-char hash

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves /home/user/Desktop/panda.jpeg from the VM and computes average RGB brightness using PIL+numpy — appropriate for verifying brightness adjustment.
Metric checks avg_brightness >= 117.0; original panda.jpeg has ~97.2 avg brightness, so initial state correctly fails (negative control resistance is satisfied).
After a +50 GIMP brightness adjustment, expected avg brightness ~147.2 which comfortably exceeds the 117.0 threshold.
Threshold 117.0 is intentionally lenient (~original+20) to tolerate JPEG re-compression artifacts when exporting — standard practice for file-based image evaluation.
Error handling in the getter is robust: handles missing file, import errors, and returns structured dict consumed correctly by the metric.
Minor concern: threshold would also pass if brightness was only increased by ~20 instead of the required +50, making the evaluator somewhat lenient on the exact magnitude.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider raising min_brightness threshold closer to 130-135 to more strictly enforce that a substantial (+50) brightness increase occurred, while still tolerating JPEG compression variance.
